1879073224.name: Wild Strike
1879073224.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879073480.name: Return to the Shire
1879073480.desc: Your skill as a hobbit allows you to find a path back to The Shire. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879099080.name: Mentor: Harp
1879099080.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the harp.

1879102536.name: Share The Fun
1879102536.desc: Share Stealth with one ally while remaining within 5m of one another.

1879104840.name: Curse of Deadly Sorrows
1879104840.desc: Douse opponent with corrosive liquid that weakens their armour and releases a soporific gas that reduces Fate, Tactical Mastery, Armour, Resistance, and Finesse.

1879130696.name: Eldar's Slash
1879130696.desc: A close-ranged attack that will hit multiple targets.

1879136968.name: Serration
1879136968.desc: A spinning attack that can damage multiple targets around you.

1879164104.name: Direct Soldier
1879164104.desc: Direct your Soldier to engage the selected foe.

1879212104.name: Specimen Jar: Gross Bugs
1879212104.desc: It's a bit redundant to call these 'Gross Bugs' as all bugs are inherently gross.

1879213896.name: Exposed (Tactical)
1879213896.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879217096.name: Resonance - Stance
1879217096.desc:
A healing stance, wherein the Minstrel's restorative abilities are at their finest.<rgb=#FF7700>

Major Ballad becomes a healing Ballad.

Echoes of Battle Becomes The Melody of Battle.

Coda of Melody becomes Coda of Resonance.</rgb>

Only one Stance may be active at a time.

1879242312.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879242312.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline allows the Lore-master to turn their attention to the elements and natural aspects of the world around them.

1879245640.name: Oration of Embers
1879245640.desc: A quick reflection on the power of words yields a damaging or inspiring effect to the Rune-keeper's enemies or allies.

1879250760.name: Enduring Embers
1879250760.desc:
Using your knowledge of fire and all that burns, you heave handfuls of pitch soaked embers at your target. They burn hotter and hotter over time.

When your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will deal additional damage. <rgb=#FF7700>

The effects from this skill can stack up to 3 times.</rgb>

1879271240.name: Fury of Blades
1879271240.desc: Deals AoE damage in front of the Champion.\n\nDamage is increased by 30% per pip consumed.

1879271752.name: Cataclysmic Shout
1879271752.desc: Deals damage and stuns surrounding enemies.\n\nApplies Guardian debuffs and some bleeds to affected targets.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.

1879272264.name: Concession and Rebuttal
1879272264.desc:
Grants additional effects to the following skills: 

 Sustaining Bolt: Restores more Morale 
 Writ of Lightning: Applies max rank of debuff and builds double Battle Attunement 
 Epic Conclusion: Leaves a trailing DoT for a portion of the damage dealt 
 Shocking Words: Becomes AoE and slows targets for 5s after being stunned.
 
 Cannot be cast out of combat.

1879276104.name: Eye for an Eye
1879276104.desc: Every strike against you will cause your attackers pain.

1879277000.name: Tripwire
1879277000.desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879295432.name: Tripwire
1879295432.desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, sometimes creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879302600.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Oath-bound)
1879302600.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879315144.name: Snap Shot - Ambush of Light
1879315144.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879316040.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879316040.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus to steeling yourself against the enemy's attack, drawing their ire and defending your allies from enemy assaults.

1879316168.name: Pond Frog
1879316168.desc: Summons a pond frog to keep you company.

1879368648.name: Blue Peacock
1879368648.desc: Brings out a blue peacock to keep you company.

1879385800.name: Fiery Yellow Beetle
1879385800.desc: Brings out a fiery yellow beetle to keep you company.

1879391432.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Maid-at-arms)
1879391432.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879411400.name: Sinister Cross
1879411400.desc: A strong punch that generates Mettle.\n\nSinister Set-up: If a Sinister Cross is the most recent Set-up Attack used, the next Mettle Spender will tier-up any available Innate Strength buffs twice instead of once. If no Innate Strength buffs have been unlocked via Trait Set Bonuses, this has no effect.

procEffects.description: When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a modest Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a significant Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a powerful Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Builders reduce the cooldown of particular skills.

1879411784.name: Ignore Pain
1879411784.desc: Unwilling to acknowledge even debilitating injuries, Brawlers often focus on developing the willpower to fight through normally insurmountable pain.\n\nRemoves Fears, Diseases, Poisons, and Wounds from yourself.

1879451336.name: Doom of the North
1879451336.desc: Remind your foes of the doom of the North Kingdoms, dealing massive frost damage after a brief delay.

1879455560.name: Spooky Barrow-lurker
1879455560.desc: Summons a spooky barrow-lurker to scare off your enemies.

1879460552.name: Guide to Carn Dûm
1879460552.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Carn Dûm.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879476808.name: Lion Cub
1879476808.desc: Summons a lion cub to accompany you on your journeys.

1879486024.name: Friend of the Wilds (Dune-guardian)
1879486024.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879495368.name: Memory of Mercy
1879495368.desc: A Memory of Mercy can be used to shield an ally, assuming some of their damage yourself.

1879528264.name: Prepared: Flame Breath
1879528264.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of flame in front of you.
